name: A World for two
steps: Help the newlyweds remove all the hidden intruders from the room.
Fix the floor crack and air vent with tape, then turn off the camera.
Remove the people hiding in the wardrobe, behind the bed, and inside the cart.
Move the picture frame, close the curtains, and place the cat in its carrier.
Finally, pull away the rug to remove the man hiding under the bed.
